description: TypeScript trigger bridge. Ends lighting overrides recorded in sensor.ls_overrides by the rules set on /lighting-schedule: after a set time (input_boolean.ls_ovr_after_on, input_number.ls_ovr_after_min) and at a clock time every day (input_boolean.ls_ovr_at_on, input_datetime.ls_ovr_at). The next-block rule (input_boolean.ls_ovr_next_block_on) lives in script.ls_apply. Removing a record makes the engine re-apply the schedule.
